Hi, I'm a tech enthusiast with a passion for mathematics, computer science, and programming. I write about topics that fascinate me—ranging from computational geometry and computer graphics to game development and low-level optimization. Most of my work is in C++ and Python, and I enjoy exploring the intersection of theory and implementation.
